reviewItem.question: Does "MTU auto-detection will now use the lowest MTU of all external interfaces" mean a change to protocol-behavior:cilium|name=mtu-auto-detection (behavior-changed)?

change.after: "lowest MTU of all external interfaces is used"

proposed.statement: Cilium MTU auto-detection now uses the lowest MTU of all external interfaces instead of only the primary interface (ENI secondary interfaces excluded); manual MTU configuration still works.
